messages:
maria: Heads up team 1 1 we need a micro-asset pack for the inbound benchmark launch: 1 hero banner (1200x628), 4 square microtiles (1080x1080), 2 story sizes (1080x1920), and a small sales sticker (600x314). Include EN/DE/FR copy. Deadline: next Tue COB.
ben: Noted. Do you want an a/b headline variant for the hero? testing on socials next week.
maria: Yes please 1 Variant A: product-first headline. Variant B: outcome-first headline. Keep body copy identical.
ash: For localization we'll need a key file with exact strings. I'll handle DE/FR if you give the source keys.
maria: Keys: hero_head_1, hero_head_2, hero_sub, tile_cta, sticker_cta. Also include alt text keys for each asset.
designbot: Created export job id=E789 frames=[hero, tile-1, tile-2, tile-3, tile-4, story-1, story-2, sales-sticker] variants=[A,B,a11y-high-contrast,a11y-large-type] outputs=[png:1200x628,png:1080x1080,png:1080x1920,png:600x314,svg,pptx]. ETA ~12m.
sam: Quick copy guidance: legal prefers "up to" for comparative stats and asks that percentage claims include a short methodology footnote. I'll draft microcopy after exports.
legal-ops: Confirming: use qualifiers ("up to" or "median"). Any translated copy that includes numbers must match the English approved phrasing exactly. We'll need the translation strings before we can sign off.
ara: Accessibility ask: for story sizes ensure text is safe within a 120px margin, and avoid reliance on color alone for meaning. Provide a plain-text caption for each animated asset.
ben: Good call. For the animated hero (subtle draw) include a 2-frame static fallback PNG for platforms that don't support gif autoplay. Keep animation <2s.
maria: Also want a small brand-compliance checklist attached to the exports: logo spacing, color hex list, approved type styles, and do-not-use tone examples.
designbot: Exports queued to /figma/bench/exports/1811112222/ 1 files will be: hero_A_en.png, hero_B_en.png, tile-1_a11y-hc_fr.png, story-1_a11y-lt_de.png, sales-sticker_default.svg, brand-checklist.pdf.
nash: I'll populate the translation sheet at https://docs.redwood/marketing/bench-localization and add a column "legal_flag" for numeric strings.
legal-ops: Once translations are in the sheet we'll review within 24 hours. Flag any claims with percent signs.
sam: I'll draft the alt-text following a11y guidelines: concise, first-sentence summary then context. Will push to the copy doc and link here.
maria: Ops ask: after assets are final please upload to CDN path /assets/bench/launch/1811112222 and to the sales drive. Sam can you confirm upload?
sam: Confirmed 1 I'll upload final PNG/MP4/SVG and add a small manifest.json with filenames and alt-text keys.
ben: Anything else? If not I'll start the a/b creative for the hero and share quick previews in #design-review.
maria: That's it. Thanks all 680 We'll reconvene after legal sign-off or if any localization issues pop up.
